exposure: impacted foetal head at caesarean section
cervical dilation at time of CS
outcome: incidence of impacted foetal head at CS in labour
difficulty in delivering the foetal head
cohort: Women undergoing CS during a 12-month period in a single unit
finding: Difficulty delivering the foetal head at caesarean section (CS) is common, especially when cervical dilation is ≥8 cm, and is associated with increased maternal blood loss.
